scripts.build: pnpm --filter @backgammon/core build && pnpm --filter @backgammon/runtime build && pnpm --filter @backgammon/web build
scripts.lint: pnpm format:check && pnpm --filter @backgammon/core lint && pnpm --filter @backgammon/runtime lint && pnpm --filter @backgammon/web lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @backgammon/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @backgammon/runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @backgammon/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @backgammon/core test && pnpm --filter @backgammon/runtime test && pnpm --filter @backgammon/web test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @backgammon/core test:coverage && pnpm --filter @backgammon/runtime test:coverage && pnpm --filter @backgammon/web test:coverage
